myanmar.title: Flag of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar

colors.note: Represents solidarity among the nation's ethnic groups
Represents peace, tranquillity, and the country's lush landscape
The central star represents the union of the country

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of yellow, green, and red with a large white five-pointed star in the centre
- Adopted on 21 October 2010 under the 2008 constitution, replacing the socialist-era flag used since 1974

countryData.name: Myanmar
countryData.officialName: Republic of the Union of Myanmar

trivia:
- The tricolour bands echo those on the 1943-1945 flag used during Japanese occupation
- The white star was enlarged compared to the colonial-era and socialist predecessors
- Myanmar is also widely known as Burma, a name still used by several governments and organisations
